agreement.note: Both reviewers returned the same state for every packet-tier cell. This is exploratory agreement, not a population reliability estimate.

decision_rule.T0: not_identifiable: name/version alone does not establish release-level remediation lineage
decision_rule.T1: not_identifiable: package/target identity alone does not establish release-level remediation lineage
decision_rule.T3: identified when at least one changed path has post_path_exists=true and post_blob_matches_remediation_commit=true; otherwise not_identifiable
decision_rule.T4: identified when every observed changed path matches; conditional when some but not all match; not_identifiable when none match

limitations: T2 packet wording should explicitly define contains as commit ancestry/reachability.
T3/T4 should define exact path and blob quantifiers before a preregistered study.
Agreement is on 12 hash-selected packets and does not establish general inter-rater reliability.
No state is a CVE affected/not_affected label or exploitability claim.
